description: Risk-based position sizing for trading agents: from account balance, risk per trade (percent or fixed amount), entry and stop price returns units to buy/sell, notional, leverage needed, stop distance, and with a target the reward:risk ratio, profit at target and break-even win rate. Optional fees and lot-size rounding. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/position-size

feePct.description: Fee per side in percent of notional (included in the risk)

lotSize.description: Round units down to this step (e.g. 0.001 BTC, 1 share)

riskPct.description: Percent of the account to risk

stopPrice.description: Stop loss; below entry = long, above = short

name: position_size
title: Position Size
